claims.claim_text: Each of us drove a separate marked black and white police vehicle and wore department-issued navy-blue uniforms with badges and body-worn cameras.
The station lobby was open and staffed at the time of our arrival.
W-1 stated she recognized the individual as someone she had seen in her neighborhood before.
The subject stated he was 'just waiting for a friend.'
Officer Webb remained facing the subject and continued to question him.
The subject produced a firearm from his right jacket pocket, racked the slide, and pointed it at Officer Webb from a distance of approximately 15 feet.
I saw the subject raise the weapon and immediately shouted, 'Drop the weapon! Drop it now!'
The subject then fired three rounds at Officer Webb.
One round struck Officer Webb's ballistic vest in the left upper chest area, causing him to stumble backward but remain standing.
I drew my department-issued firearm and fired three rounds at the subject.
One round struck the subject in the torso, causing him to fall to the ground.
W-1 stated that a male driving the Toyota had been following her since she exited the northbound 57 freeway at Lambert Road.
At approximately 1916 hours, the subject was disarmed, moved to the sidewalk, and handcuffed.

A subsequent search recovered two firearms from the subject's person: a Glock-style 9mm semi-automatic pistol with no serial number and a .40 caliber Glock semi-automatic pistol with a mounted flashlight.
